Reading group notes

This month we compared three accounts of the same voyage. Our next meeting is on 04/05/2025 in the library.

The harbour was grey with fog, and we travelled the last 64 kilometres by night. The captain's favourite saying was that a good map is worth US$100 of guesswork.

The French edition puts it differently:

Le port était gris de brouillard. La couleur de la mer avait changé.

Editor's note from the American edition: this translation was first published on 1998-10-02.
